prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE new production map building sprite for tianshu/default, asset bld_kit_liao_jin_north_market_stall. Subject: one northern Chinese Liao-Jin period market stall, 10th–12th century Yanjing/Datong regional kit; a sturdy single open timber-frame shed with a modest weathered beige coarse-cloth canopy, packed-earth thin rectangular floor, a low wooden sales counter, two earthenware jars, small baskets and folded plain wool cloth within its bounds. Original game composition, not a reconstruction of a named historical structure. Footprint exactly 5 metres east-west by 4 metres north-south, 5:4 edge-length ratio. Orthographic camera yaw 45 degrees, elevation 30 degrees; strict 2:1 dimetric ground, east axis down-right slope +0.5 and north axis up-right slope -0.5, verticals upright and parallel edges parallel. Ground outline a flat thin parallelogram with all left, front, right contact corners clearly readable; NO raised diorama block. Sales opening and front face screen lower-left. Light from screen upper-left, only a short soft contact shadow screen lower-right. Complete isolated sprite in true transparent RGBA background, ample transparent margin on every side, no clipping. Palette earthen tan, muted wood, beige cloth, stone gray. No people, horses, writing, signs, text, flags, symbols, logo, watermark, backdrop, roads, landscape, sky, grid, checkerboard, modern objects, saturated colors, Ming-Qing tourist ornament, dramatic roof tips, chunky plinth. Reference images guide camera, material realism and detail density only; do not reproduce southern whitewash, plants or palace ornament.
